prompt:
Below is the text of a document found in a landscape drawing package (extracted from a PDF). Classify it: 'spec' (a standard or specification that sets rules, dimensions or measurement methods), 'quote' (a supplier's priced quotation), 'bill' (a bill of quantities) or 'document' (anything else: meeting notes, review comments, checklists, letters). Give its title as written, a one-sentence summary, up to six key facts a reviewer pricing the landscape works must know (keep numbers exactly as written), and, if the document lists documents or deliverables, each one with its status as written (for example 'required'). Confidence from 0 to 1; why in one sentence.

--- document text ---
Planting procurement spec — Landscape Works
Greenfield Residences · supply, measurement and pricing rules for the bill of quantities ·
2026 (sample)
1. Plant material
•  Nursery grown, root-balled, true to the botanical name on the plant schedule.
•  Trees: caliper measured 1.0 m above ground; height and spread within 10% of the schedule.
•  Substitutions only with the designer's written approval.
2. Measurement
•  Quantities are measured net from the drawings; plant quantities on plan take precedence over
   the schedule.
•  Trees and shrubs by number of plants; hedges by number of plants at the stated spacing, not
   by length.
•  Beds, lawn and paving by area in m²; edges by length in m.
3. Pricing
•  Unit rates include supply, planting and 12 months of establishment maintenance.
•  Prices in NT$, excluding the 5% business tax; overhead and profit stated separately.
4. Paving
Code
Material
Specification
PV-1
Permeable pavers
concrete, 200 x 100 x 80 mm, on 30 mm sand
PV-2
Exposed aggregate
100 mm, 6-10 mm aggregate
PV-3
Grass pavers
concrete grid 400 x 400 x 80 mm, soil and sod
Material samples and photos are submitted for approval before ordering.
